decision_card.headline: Directional only; resolve QC or stability risks before budget-level decisions.
policy_rules: RED: QC gate FAIL, or QC gate missing while diagnostics include FAIL runs.
YELLOW: QC gate REVIEW/missing, diagnostics beyond green limits, or stable-baseline sensitivity >= 15.0%.
GREEN: QC gate PASS, diagnostics within limits (FAIL <= 0, REVIEW <= 5), and stable-baseline sensitivity < 15.0%.
Prior guardrail: YELLOW if any row has P(ROI<0) > 0.20.
PASS coverage gate: GREEN requires PASS coverage >= 60.0%.
Robustness band gate: GREEN requires robustness band HIGH.
triggered_rules: YELLOW rule: QC gate result is REVIEW.
YELLOW rule: diagnostics FAIL runs (8) exceed green limit (0).
YELLOW rule: diagnostics REVIEW runs (9) exceed green limit (5).
YELLOW rule: PASS coverage 5.6% (8/144, scope=pass_only) is below green minimum 60.0%.
reasons: Broad exploration diagnostics: PASS 5.6%, REVIEW 9, FAIL 8.
QC gate window: 18 run(s), PASS 1, REVIEW 9, FAIL 8.
Robustness score: 44.70/100 (Medium), weighting=spend, runs=9, tag=google_meta_tiktok. Target-subset score=27.82/100.
Percent-change safeguard: 8/8 channel-prior pair(s) had unstable baseline ROI; those pairs are ranked by |Delta ROI| instead of % change.
Prior guardrail: 0 run(s), 0/144 row(s) exceed threshold P(ROI<0)>0.20 (0.0%), max P(ROI<0)=0.00.
Most sensitive channel-prior pair under safeguard: tiktok (LogNormal), max |Delta ROI|=0.0544 (baseline unstable for % metric).
actions: Keep conclusions directional; avoid hard budget shifts from single-run snapshots.
Prioritize reruns around the most sensitive channel-prior combinations.
Require QC gate PASS plus robustness score before production decision workflow.

notes: Immediate vs carryover shares are derived from normalized adstock decay weights.
